title: Otter dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- otter body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='18' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='16' r='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='16' r='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='16' r='2.5' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='16' r='2.5' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='27' r='3' fill='#2E1A0F'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='27' r='3' fill='#2E1A0F'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='26' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#2E1A0F'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 39 Q50 43 55 39' stroke='#2E1A0F' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M39 35 L30 33 M39 38 L30 39 M61 35 L70 33 M61 38 L70 39' stroke='#F0D8B8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M32 55 Q18 48 14 34' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='31' r='4' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- right arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M68 55 Q82 48 86 34' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='31' r='4' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- left foot kicked up -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='84' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#6B3F1A' transform='rotate(-25 30 84)'/>
  <!-- right foot planted -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='86' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#6B3F1A' transform='rotate(15 66 86)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 82 Q84 82 86 68' stroke='#6B3F1A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 62 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <path d='M80 60 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='52' r='2' fill='#7FE7FF'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='2' fill='#7FE7FF'/>
</svg>
